These are 18 MOBILE (375x812) frames, not desktop layout explorations, and they are SKAI's own work (Skai chrome, Skai type, current card set), not borrowed art. 11 of 18 assessed this pass: 2 are the mobile root list (10199-104649, 10202-112785) drawn with the same three card archetypes and closing FAQ accordion as 10509-18308, so they track the root's verdict; 6 are the short-window "Bitcoin 5min (up/down)" market in various states (chart type, order book, trade sheet, settlement) and are stamped not-wired; 3 (10211-14686, 10252-79268, 10252-84286) are full-scroll frames that could only be rendered as unreadable thumbnails and are stamped deferred with their height evidence. Mobile (10594-61136, 10594-58911, 10594-60147), tablet (10654-198325, 10654-199581) and desktop (10654-200390) tier of the venue-generic detail. PredictMarketDetail is routed and renders header/chart/modules/related/comments/rules/FAQ/trade panel and reflows to one column, but the frame centres on an 11-row asks/bids book with Last and Spread, and that cannot render: both HIP-4 venues are CPMM, so OrderBookPanel.tsx ships an honest "This market has no order book" notice plus the pool reserves instead. The frame also fills Related events with Solana 5min / Dogecoin 30min / Tron 15min up-down markets, a short-window market type no venue implements. No 375/768 composition was authored or diffed.

Full-scroll root at mobile (10509-18308) and tablet (10642-185390): search row, horizontally scrolling category nav, single-column card list, "Show more markets", then an FAQ accordion. TWO OF THE THREE GAPS CLOSED 2026-08-05. (1) The FAQ block now renders on the root as src/components/predict/PredictFaq.tsx — the detail-page FaqPanel could not be reused because buildFaq() is market-scoped and there is no market in scope on the root, so this is a platform-level accordion with the frame's four questions. (2) The multi-date grouped card is built as src/components/predict/GroupedMarketCard.tsx over src/lib/predict/eventGroups.ts, which folds sibling markets that differ only by a trailing deadline into one card; every row still shows its own market's real price and trades through its own venue modal, and the match rule is deliberately strict (same venue, same category, stem ≥20 chars, 2–6 rows) so unrelated markets are never presented as one event. STILL OPEN: the two-team three-odds sports card — DECLINED, not deferred, because no SKAI venue is 3-outcome and the DRAW button would have to carry an invented price.

Figma 10597-63994 / 10597-64475 / 10654-203686 / 10654-206593 draw a live plus "Starting soon" sports board: per-event cards carrying two team rows, each with three priced odds buttons (e.g. "LVLUP +1.5 35c"). Nothing under src/pages/predict or src/components/predict* renders a two-team three-odds card - UnifiedMarketCard is a single-question Yes/No card and FuturesMarketCard is a candidate ranking. The only two-team sportsbook in the repo is src/pages/sports/Sports.tsx at /sports (and sports.skai.trade), a separate IA that no /predict route and no PredictSubNav tab links to.

Mobile (10539-46305, 10545-47421) and tablet (10654-197572, 10710-132119) stack four blocks: a hero card, a numbered 1-15 movers list (question + chance + delta), a "Get daily updates" email-capture card, and a "Live from @skai.predict" timestamped signals feed. Only the hero has an implementation and it is PredictHero rendering its honest no-featured-market shell; the movers list is exactly where PredictInsightsPanel renders "No probability movement to rank yet" (implementable - see the 'breaking' row - not structurally impossible); the email-capture card and the @skai.predict feed have no component and no backend anywhere in src.

Mobile (10597-66077, 10710-131349) and tablet (10654-208482, 10710-132635) tier of the futures list: heading, three-tab nav, and ranking cards ("Premier League winner", "2nd/3rd Place winner", "Last place", "Relegated club") whose rows are avatar + percentage + probability bar - which is FuturesMarketCard, and the screen grid collapses to one column below lg. Held at partial because /predict/futures only renders this screen when REDESIGN_PREDICT is on (src/config/features.ts:210, defaults OFF; the route otherwise falls back to legacy <Predict/>), and no 375/768 composition was authored or diffed against these frames.
